evidence: frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/forms/components/FormRenderer.tsx:35-40 — validateForm()'s required-field check is too narrow: `if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '')`. It only treats a missing string as empty, so three of the component's own field types bypass required validation and submit an 'empty' value: (1) NUMBER fields (case 'number', :164-169) store `Number.parseFloat(e.target.value)`; clearing the input makes parseFloat('') === NaN, and `NaN === '' / null / undefined` are all false, so a required number field left blank (NaN) PASSES and is submitted (NaN serializes to JSON null). (2) CHECKBOX fields (case 'checkbox', :195-202) store `e.target.checked`; an unchecked required checkbox is `false`, and `false === '' / null / undefined` are all false, so a mandatory consent/acknowledgement checkbox can be submitted UNCHECKED. (3) MULTISELECT fields (case 'multiselect', :249-256) store an array; an empty selection is `[]`, which is not `=== '' / null / undefined`, so a required multiselect with zero options chosen also PASSES.

Reachability confirmed static: handleSubmit (:67-75) gates onSubmit solely on validateForm() returning true; the required check at :35-40 is the only gate for these types (email/phone have extra regex at :43-56 but those are string-typed). No other guard exists. The required marker is rendered for all field types (:323 `{field.required && ...*}`), so the UI advertises these fields as mandatory while the validator does not enforce them.

Impact MEDIUM (+2): a correctness bug on a user-facing, wired form-filling surface (FillFormPage mounts FormRenderer). A cleared required numeric answer submits as null and a required consent checkbox submits as false/unchecked — the latter is the material case for forms that gate on an acknowledgement. The regex branches at :43,51 already use `formData[field.id]` truthiness, so the author's model of 'filled' is string-centric; the number/boolean/array types were not accounted for.

Fix vector (frontend-only, cloud-landable, frontend.yml + vitest verifiable): make the emptiness test type-aware — treat NaN as empty for number fields, require `value === true` for a required checkbox, and treat an empty array as empty for multiselect (e.g. `const empty = value === undefined || value === null || value === '' || (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isNaN(value)) || (Array.isArray(value) && value.length === 0) || (field.fieldType === 'checkbox' && value !== true);`). Add RTL tests asserting a required number/checkbox/multiselect left blank blocks submit. Confidence MEDIUM: the missing cases are statically certain; not upgraded to high because the server may re-validate (not traced). NET-NEW: distinct from the reality-web/mobile-rn FormRenderer rows in prior signals (different app + file); no ppt-web forms-validation finding exists in backlog.json.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/compliance/hooks/useAmlDashboard.ts:85-89 — the AML dashboard issues three queries: useAmlAssessments (whose `error` is destructured as `assessmentsError` and exposed on UseAmlDashboardResult), useAmlThresholds() and useCountryRisks(). The latter two destructure only `data` (`thresholdsData`, `countryRisksData`); their `.error`/`.isError` are never read and the hook's return type (:30-59) has no field for them. So a thresholds or country-risk fetch failure is silently dropped.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/compliance/pages/AmlDashboardPage.tsx:66-76 — the page renders a single error branch keyed off `assessmentsError` only. When useAmlThresholds/useCountryRisks fail, `thresholds` falls to null (:128-135) and `countryRisks` to [] (:137-143), so AmlThresholdsSection and AmlCountryRisksTable render as empty/absent panels with NO error indication and NO retry — a failed load is indistinguishable from 'no thresholds configured' / 'no high-risk countries'. This is inconsistent with the assessments panel in the same screen, which does surface an error, and with the hardened mutation paths (submitEdd/submitReview) that toast on error (:179-186, :210-217).

Impact LOW (+1): no crash or auth impact, but on a regulated AML/KYC surface a compliance officer can read stale/empty FATF country-risk and monetary-threshold panels as authoritative 'empty' when the underlying fetch actually 500'd — a silent-failure/data-trust gap, not just a cosmetic one. Confidence MEDIUM (static): the dropped `.error` destructures and the single-source error branch are confirmed by full read of both files; runtime behaviour on a thresholds 500 not executed.

Fix vector (frontend-only, cloud-landable, frontend.yml verifiable): expose `thresholdsError`/`countryRisksError` from useAmlDashboard and either fold them into the page's top-level error branch or render per-section error+retry states in AmlThresholdsSection / AmlCountryRisksTable. NET-NEW: distinct from the existing AML rows (risk_factors.map crash; hardcoded-false compliance fields + recommendations:[]; window.prompt untrusted-cast; prompt/alert i18n) — none of those cover the unsurfaced thresholds/country-risk query errors.
